name: Golden Designs Gargellen 5-Person Outdoor Hybrid Sauna (PureTech™ Full Spectrum Infrared & Harvia SWS80)
description: Golden Designs Gargellen 5-Person Outdoor Hybrid Sauna (PureTech™ Full Spectrum Infrared & Harvia SWS80) Indulge in the perfect balance of tradition and modern wellness with the Golden Designs Gargellen 5-Person Hybrid Outdoor Sauna. This exceptional outdoor sauna offers the versatility of two sauna experiences in one, allowing you to embrace the classic benefits of a traditional sauna or bask in the revitalizing power of full-spectrum infrared therapy. Unparalleled Versatility: The Gargellen sauna caters to your unique wellness needs with its hybrid design. Choose the traditional sauna mode, where soothing steam envelopes your body, promoting relaxation and detoxification. Alternatively, relish the gentle warmth of full-spectrum infrared therapy, known for its deep tissue penetration and rejuvenating effects. Experience the perfect sauna session tailored to your preferences. Exquisite Craftsmanship: The Gargellen sauna boasts an all-Canadian Hemlock exterior, showcasing the beauty of natural wood while providing exceptional durability and resistance to the elements. Its traditional design effortlessly complements your outdoor space, creating a seamless connection with nature. Outdoor Sanctuary: Step into an outdoor sanctuary of wellness and tranquility in the comfort of your backyard. The Gargellen sauna beckons you to unwind and rejuvenate with family and friends, enveloped in the warmth of the sauna and surrounded by the beauty of nature. Clear Water Protection: Crafted with longevity in mind, the Golden Designs Gargellen sauna features an exterior clear water protection stain. This protective layer preserves the wood's beauty, ensuring it remains in pristine condition for years to come. With an annual re-application, your sauna will continue to be a captivating addition to your outdoor living space. Elevate Your Sauna Experience: Elevate your sauna experience to new heights with the Golden Designs Gargellen 5-Person Hybrid Outdoor Sauna. This elegantly designed and expertly crafted sauna provides an exceptional fusion of tradition and innovation, offering you the freedom to choose the sauna session that best suits your well-being. Unlock the limitless possibilities of relaxation, detoxification, and rejuvenation with the Gargellen sauna - your gateway to the ultimate wellness retreat. Features 5-person capacity 100% natural reforested Canadian Hemlock with waterproof exterior stain Interior chromotherapy lighting system Interior backrest with accent lighting Exterior front overhang accent lighting Interior LED control panel with built-in FM radio and Bluetooth connection Built-in performance speakers Sandglass, thermometer, bucket, and ladle Stainless steel hinge and handle Full Spectrum IR: Total 10 IR Emitters. 4 Carbon PureTech™ Near Zero EMF Heat Emitters (Heating Panels) and 6 Near Infrared Heat Emitters (Heating Elements) Harvia SWS80 The Wall 8 kW Traditional Sauna Stove with built-in Controls Specifications Electrical service: 240V / 40AMP (Stove & Full Spectrum) (Please consult a certified electrician.)
